meta.name: Koko target
meta.description: Keep what only Koko has (the pixel city, pixel avatars, critters, the scrapbook pages) and make everything around it as quiet and confident as the references. Implemented in styles.css 2026.10.07c.

primary.role: primary buttons, selected chips, active tab, toasts (light); flips to #f3ede4 at night

secondary.role: Koko gold: stars, the + button, the map selection, tape. Used sparingly so it means something

neutral.usage: Warm-neutral paper replaces peach; ink #1d1712 for text and primary actions

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast: ink on warm paper; white cards with a soft shadow; dark mode #141210 with cream ink

measurement.source: tests/e2e/shots/e-08-log-380-light.png after the paint pass (the implementation, not a reference)

font_families.heading: Plus Jakarta Sans 800
font_families.mono: Space Mono only on paper: postage stamps, page dates, the recap spread. Silkscreen only on map labels

typography.font_style_notes: One family. Tight tracking on headings, sentence case labels, no uppercase mono in the chrome. The typewriter face is a property of the scrapbook pages, not of the app.

spacing.section_rhythm: Fewer boxes; groups separated by space, not by nested tinted cards

layout.alignment_tendency: left for content, centered for onboarding

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px on inputs, search and secondary buttons
shape.divider_style: hairline under the frosted top bar

elevation.depth_cues: soft shadows and the frosted top bar; no offset slabs

motion.easing: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); spring cubic-bezier(.34,1.36,.64,1) for the two signature moments only
motion.entrance_pattern: screens glide in from the right, sheets rise; catch: pop, then sparkles and text rise in sequence
motion.philosophy: minimal functional, with two signature moments (taped in, critter caught)

components.button_style: pill; primary is ink with paper text and a soft lift; secondary is white with a hairline
components.input_style: white field, 1px hairline, ink border on focus
components.card_style: white or neutral card, 18px radius, soft shadow, no card-in-card
components.navigation_pattern: bottom bar, sentence-case labels, ink for the active tab, one gold + as the only colour
components.modal_style: bottom sheet, 28px top radius, frosted scrim
components.component_notes: Selected = ink fill (chips) or white pill on a neutral track (segments). Gold is never a selection colour.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a good notebook: quiet cover, lively pages
aesthetic.era_influence: 2025-26 editorial iOS with a pixel-art heart
aesthetic.genre: premium consumer with a playful core

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents (tape and stamps live on the pages only)
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: the map or the page is the hero; chrome recedes
visual_language.texture_usage: none in the chrome; paper and tape on scrapbook pages

composition.negative_space_role: lets the pixel art and photos breathe

imagery.photo_treatment: polaroid with tape inside the scrapbook; plain rounded elsewhere
imagery.illustration_style: isometric pixel city, pixel avatars, pixel critters (unchanged)
imagery.image_shape: rounded rectangle; square polaroid on pages

interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: low, except the two signature moments

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: plain and warm; say what it is ("Notes", "Photos", "Who’s been")
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: plain, says what to do next

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to CSS; reduced motion and calm mode remove all animation

particle_systems.description: Three pixel sparkles on the critter catch, staggered 100 ms apart

3d_elements.description: The isometric map is drawn in 2D, not WebGL

image_effects.description: Photos sit in polaroid frames with tape, rotated a degree or two

canvas_drawings.description: The pixel city map, unchanged: it is the hero

params.draw_method: isometric tiles, sprites and labels redrawn on pan and zoom
params.animation_loop: on demand, plus a slow twinkle at night
params.color_scheme: pixel palette: sand, sea teal, tower blue, park green

svg_animations.description: Icons are a font; no SVG animation

visual_effects.composite_notes: Restraint everywhere except the map and the two signature moments. Taped in: tape is pulled across (scaleX from the left) and the page settles under it. Critter caught: spring pop, two-step pixel breathing, three sparkles twinkling in sequence, name and fact rising after. All off under prefers-reduced-motion and calm mode.
